certificate.title: Set Up and Use Claude Inside Excel for Finance Work Completion

course.description: Install Claude in Excel and immediately start using it for data cleanup, formula help, model auditing, and report generation.
learningOutcomes: Apply the methods taught in Set Up and Use Claude Inside Excel for Finance Work.

lessons.content: Open Excel → Insert → Get Add-ins → Search "Claude by Anthropic" → Install. Open the sidebar with Ctrl+Option+C (Mac). Total setup: 2 minutes.
lessons.title: Install the Claude Excel add-in

lessons.content: This is where Claude in Excel is most immediately valuable. Feed it messy vendor names, inconsistent date formats, or duplicate entries. Claude catches everything. This alone saves hours every week.
lessons.title: Start with data cleanup

activities.title: Use it for formula writing and debugging

lessons.content: Describe what you need in plain English and get a traceable formula with an explanation. Stop Googling nested INDEX/MATCH — just ask.
lessons.title: Use it for formula writing and debugging

lessons.content: Prompt: "Check this model for broken references, circular errors, and hard-coded numbers that should be formulas." Claude acts as a second pair of eyes that never gets tired. It finds things you miss.
lessons.title: Run model audits

lessons.content: Run a variance analysis in Excel, then ask Claude to pull the key findings into a board deck format. Same conversation, same session. This used to be a Sunday night task.
lessons.title: Build the Excel → PowerPoint pipeline

lessons.content: Complex multi-year forecasting still needs heavy human review. The outputs look polished but assumptions can have gaps. In finance, 99% correct is still wrong. Never blindly trust AI output on anything that goes external.
lessons.title: Know where to be careful
